title: Deadline-Bounded Fourfold/Tensor Gardener Campaign
primary_claim: One per-user Windows task may invoke the existing bounded daedalus.loop against a revision-bound curated queue before 2026-09-29 Europe/Berlin, while a separate cutoff trigger performs no candidate execution, stops the kill switch, disables the task, and retains a final repository topology report.
gardener_invariants: prefer deletion, consolidation, movement, or wiring before new abstraction
tensor representation remains an internal typed view and never a fifth semantic plane
one responsibility moves at a time toward kernel, runtimes, orchestration, twin, or evolution
compatibility adapters are thin and carry an explicit removal condition
no branch is merged, force-updated, or deleted without containment and owner review
benchmark losses, ablations, costs, failures, and uncertainty remain inspectable
CrewAI or AlphaEvolve superiority is never inferred from architecture or an incomparable proxy
acceptance: campaign JSON rejects authority escalation, unbounded values, overlap, non-Berlin timezone, and inconsistent cutoff dates
pre-cutoff activation invokes exactly one existing daedalus.loop process with every configured bound
cutoff activation reaches finalization without invoking the loop or any candidate runner
scheduled-task installation uses IgnoreNew, Interactive logon and Limited run level and includes a distinct final trigger
a sticky operator stop cannot be silently overridden; scheduled commands never contain --force
activation and final receipts retain exact Masterplan digest/revision, repository HEAD, branch refs and worktrees
work queue is the only enabled picker source and is bound to one exact candidate base revision
policy blocks all code writes outside daedalus/twin and daedalus/evolution
scheduler source contains no merge, push, reset, promotion, OwnerApproval or PromotionReceipt operation

prepared: Python compile checks for runner and focused tests
verification.hosted_ci: blocked by issue #67; zero-step jobs are not evidence
verification.claim: source and test preparation only; no exact-head green result

rollback: run python tools/gardener_campaign.py uninstall on the owner machine
retain activation/final receipts and negative evidence
non_goals: automatic implementation of every queued item
a claim that Daedalus already beats CrewAI or AlphaEvolve
changing the adopted Masterplan or amendment chain
